description: This Java class defines a custom HTML sanitization policy using the OWASP HTML Sanitizer library. It specifies allowed HTML tags and attributes for safe user input handling, based on the Slashdot example policy.

classes.name: CustomSafePolicy
classes.description: A Java class implementing a custom HTML sanitization policy for safe user input.

methods.name: getSanitizerPolicy
methods.description: Returns the PolicyFactory object that defines the HTML sanitization rules.
